newsitem.title: USA: Amphenol issues $240 mln in 10-year debt.
newsitem.headline: Amphenol issues $240 mln in 10-year debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Amphenol Corp was priced on Tuesday, according to co-lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.

The notes are part of a recapitalization plan prompted by the proposed merger of a Kohlberg, Kravis Roberts & Co unit, NXS Acquisition Corp. Amphenol manufactures and markets coaxial and flat ribbon cable, fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems.
Lehman Brothers was also co-manager on the deal.
